sentences.en: Greenwich Village is a place which especially attracts the young.
sentences.zh: 格林威治村是一个特别吸引年轻人的地方。

sentences.en: I want to build my corporate site to attract customers.
sentences.zh: 我想建立我的企业网站来吸引客户。

sentences.en: I am attracted to a certain boy in my class.
sentences.zh: 我对班里某个男孩很有好感。

senses.zh: 吸引，  引起注意；<衍生词> attraction  n . 吸引力，吸引人的事物； attractive

mnemonic: 词根记忆：at（加强）+tract（拉）→把注意力拉过来→吸引
